task.title: Measure Workbook storage and peak resource growth
task.description:
The 2026-07-29 evaluation recorded aggregate packed Git bytes at 500 tasks by 20 operations, but did not separate durable object classes, disposable cache size, or peak runtime resources.

Using corrected representative 500-by-20 and 500-by-100 fixtures, measure operation blobs, state blobs, trees and commits, pack bytes, SQLite projection bytes, and validation-cache bytes separately. Capture peak resident memory and I/O for projection rebuild and full validation. Keep fixture construction outside measured commands and preserve equivalent deterministic data in SHA-1 and SHA-256 repositories.

Acceptance: stable JSON fields and generated Markdown report every storage component, peak resident memory, and I/O for both fixture depths and both object formats; tests prove the accounting categories and fixture metadata are complete; results remain descriptive and do not invent pass thresholds or change durability behavior.
